name: Quest VR Link
author: Nestor
description: Integration and control for Meta Quest 3 on Omarchy: dual-mode USB cable reverse tethering & wireless Wi-Fi streaming, Ultrawide 32:9 virtual monitor, auto-launching, and spatial floating HUD.

barWidget.description: Control VR streaming over Cable or Wi-Fi, toggle 32:9 Ultrawide display, monitor headset telemetry and active link status.
